subject: Signal-fire drill: final runway & commit checklist
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Signal-fire drill: final runway & commit checklist

Team —

We’re in the last push for Q2 close and I want a short, reliable rollup so finance has one clean input for ARR recognition and bookkeeping. This is a quick “signal-fire” drill: small number of asks, please treat as high priority.

High-level: BrightByte (RWI-2027-BB-019) is at verbal commitment. We need stage hygiene + commit confirmation across HubSpot, and a single source file for Finance.

Immediate asks (today):
- Sales owners (Ben): update HubSpot deal stage to "Commit" and set "Commit owner" property. Add exact PO ETA in the notes.
- CS/Account (Marissa): confirm any outstanding legal/technical blockers and attach the final SOW/attach link.
- Finance (David): confirm the revenue recognition trigger we’ll use if PO arrives before 6/30 (billing vs. delivery).
- Ops (Laura): confirm if we should enable 90-day staged deployment for the contract (affects billing timing).

Attachments: runway-summary.csv (baseline numbers + staging flags) — I’ve prefilled best-known amounts. Please do not alter columns other than "commit_flag" and "po_eta".

I’ll compile one rollup at 17:00 PT tomorrow (6/23) and circulate to execs. If anything is ambiguous, reply inline and @mention the owner.

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700

>

Got it. I updated the HubSpot stage to "Commit" and added PO ETA: 2027-06-29 (procurement says internal approvals complete).

–Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signal-fire drill: final runway & commit checklist

Adding Finance and attaching an adjusted forecast for clarity.

David — can you confirm recognition approach if PO is issued on 6/29 but invoices start 7/1? I’ve annotated the forecast_adj.xlsx (attached) with two scenarios: 
- Scenario A: Recognize as of invoice date (7/1) — defers ARR into Q3.
- Scenario B: Use signed PO date (6/29) with revenue accrual — requires finance sign-off for cutover.

Also, Legal has one small redline (indemnity paragraph) that may need vendor counsel; Ben is chasing. If legal eats more than one business day, tell us and we’ll note expected close slip.

Attachment: forecast_adj.xlsx (two-tab: baseline + scenarios)

Marissa
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Ellis <procurement@brightbyte.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Tina Shaw <legal@brightbyte.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signal-fire drill: final runway & commit checklist

Vivek/Ben —

Quick update from procurement: PO routing is complete, CFO needs the final contract redline resolved. We can issue PO by 6/29 pending legal. One ask from our side: can Redwood confirm the 5% pilot discount in writing on company letterhead (so CFO can sign off)? We attached our internal PO template for reference.

We also requested a short call with Legal (Tina) later today to walk the redline. If you can provide a pre-signed exhibit or a concession note, we’ll speed the PO.

Jordan Ellis
Senior Procurement Manager, BrightByte
Attachment: brightbyte_po_template.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Signal-fire drill: final runway & commit checklist — consolidated rollup

Team — final rollup below. I merged inputs and validated the HubSpot entries. Key points:

1) Deal status
- BrightByte: HubSpot stage = Commit (updated by Ben). PO ETA = 2027-06-29. Legal redline in flight; procurement requests written confirmation of 5% discount.

2) Finance/recognition
- David: please confirm we will use Scenario B (accrual on PO date) or Scenario A (invoice date). If Scenario B, confirm the journal entry approach and owner.

3) Attachments & sources
- Attached: runway-summary.csv (master rollup), forecast_adj.xlsx (Marissa scenarios), contract_redline.pdf (copied after Legal review).
- HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/98765

4) Next steps and owners
- Ben: get procurement confirmation (Jordan) to email a clean concession note or letterhead confirming 5% discount by EOD 6/24.
- Marissa: standby for Legal call; upload any signed SOW to Drive folder (I’ll collate).
- David: provide preferred recognition route by 12:00 PT 6/25. If silent, we default to invoice-date recognition (Scenario A).
- Laura: confirm staging plan if we need to enable phased deployment; reply by EOD 6/25.

If critical changes happen, tag me and I’ll reissue the rollup. Assuming PO on 6/29 and finance OK on accrual, I’ll mark this as committed in the final close ledger.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
